product_overview: SmartDine is a multi-tenant SaaS restaurant management backend for onboarding restaurants, authenticating users, managing menus/tables/orders, and synchronizing operational data to the cloud. It runs on Spring Boot with JWT security and restaurant-level data isolation.
core_goals: Enable secure multi-tenant restaurant onboarding with generated restaurant IDs and sync codes
Provide JWT-based authentication for restaurant users with role-aware access
Support CRUD operations for menus, tables, areas, and order workflows
Expose public provisioning endpoints for licensing handshake and remote config updates
Process outbox-driven cloud synchronization for operational events

features.name: Multi-Tenant Onboarding
features.description: Registers a new restaurant tenant with owner details, generates tenant identifiers, and optionally seeds initial restaurant data.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with restaurant name, owner, phone, password, and initial entities -> Receive 200 with success, restaurantId, syncCode, and JWT token -> Use returned token for subsequent tenant-scoped API calls
POST /auth/register with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive 400 with validation error details -> Correct payload and retry POST /auth/register to create the tenant

features.name: Authentication and Login
features.description: Authenticates restaurant users using restaurant name, phone number, or email and issues a JWT Bearer token.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid restaurant identifier and password -> Receive 200 with JWT Bearer token, syncCode, restaurantId, and environment -> Use token in Authorization header for protected endpoints such as GET /api/menu/**
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Retry POST /auth/login with correct credentials to obtain a token

features.name: Public Licensing Handshake
features.description: Allows unauthenticated clients to activate a provisioned restaurant configuration using a sync code and retrieve the full restaurant configuration.
user_flows: GET /api/public/provision/activate?code=SD-XXXXXX with a valid sync code -> Receive 200 with RestaurantConfigDTO including tables, menu, areas, waiters, and taxes -> Use returned configuration to initialize the local POS or admin environment

GET /api/public/provision/activate?syncCode=invalid-code with an unknown sync code -> Receive 404 or 400 indicating the provision could not be found or activated -> Re-enter the correct sync code and retry the activation request

features.name: Configuration Sync Update
features.description: Pushes updated restaurant configuration data such as menu, tables, areas, and waiters from the admin side to the cloud using a sync code.
user_flows: POST /api/public/provision/update-config with syncCode and updated tables, areas, waiters, and menu payloads -> Receive 200 on successful cloud update -> Confirm the next activation call reflects the new configuration

POST /api/public/provision/update-config with an invalid or missing syncCode -> Receive 400 or 401 indicating the update could not be applied -> Fix the request body and resend POST /api/public/provision/update-config

features.name: Outbox Sync Processing
features.description: Processes pending local outbox events and commits order, table, and menu changes to the cloud database.
user_flows: POST /api/sync/process with a valid JWT Bearer token -> Receive 200 after processing ORDER, TABLE, and MENU outbox events -> Verify synchronized records are committed to Cloud SQL
POST /api/sync/process without a JWT Bearer token or with an expired token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Re-authenticate via POST /auth/login and retry POST /api/sync/process

features.name: Menu Management
features.description: Provides authenticated CRUD operations for restaurant menu categories and menu items scoped to the current tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/menu/** with a valid JWT Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the tenant's menu categories and items -> Create or update menu data using POST /api/menu/** and verify the changes are returned on a subsequent GET /api/menu/**
POST /api/menu/** with malformed payload or missing authorization -> Receive 400 for validation errors or 401 Unauthorized -> Correct the payload or token and retry the menu request
DELETE /api/menu/** for an existing menu category or item with a valid token -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion -> Perform GET /api/menu/** to verify the deleted record is no longer present

features.name: Table Management
features.description: Provides authenticated CRUD operations for dining tables and area assignments within the tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/tables/** with a valid JWT Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the tenant's table and area records -> Create a new table using POST /api/tables/** and confirm it appears in the next GET /api/tables/** response
POST /api/tables/** with invalid table data or duplicate table identifier -> Receive 400 validation error or conflict response -> Fix the table details and retry POST /api/tables/**
DELETE /api/tables/** for an existing table with a valid token -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming removal -> Call GET /api/tables/** to ensure the table is no longer listed

features.name: Order Management and KOT Workflow
features.description: Creates and retrieves restaurant orders, supporting kitchen order ticket workflows and tenant-scoped order operations.
user_flows: POST /api/orders/** with a valid JWT Bearer token and order payload -> Receive 200 with order confirmation and generated order identifier -> Use GET /api/orders/** to retrieve the created order and verify its status

GET /api/orders/** with a valid JWT Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the list of tenant orders and associated KOT details -> Update or submit a new order through POST /api/orders/** and confirm the new order appears in subsequent GET results
POST /api/orders/** with invalid item references or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Correct the order payload and resend POST /api/orders/** to create the order
